_comment: Default bindings for Sonic Mania's two pads. Player 1 on the keyboard as the decompilation's own Settings.ini has it - the arrows,
A, S and D for A, B and C, Q, W and E for X, Y and Z, Enter for Start, Tab for Select - and on the first pad; player 2 on the second pad.
Players 3 and 4 are the third and fourth pads, as player 2 is the second. Dev Menu is Escape, as the decompilation opens its developer menu.

Sonic Mania.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
Sonic Mania.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Sonic Mania.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Sonic Mania.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
Sonic Mania.P2 Up: J2 POV1U, X2 DpadUp, X2 LStickUp
Sonic Mania.P2 Down: J2 POV1D, X2 DpadDown, X2 LStickDown
Sonic Mania.P2 Left: J2 POV1L, X2 DpadLeft, X2 LStickLeft
Sonic Mania.P2 Right: J2 POV1R, X2 DpadRight, X2 LStickRight

Sonic Mania.P3 Right: J3 POV1R, X3 DpadRight, X3 LStickRight
